description: In every old-language structure, the total unique graph sentence holds exactly when every input tuple has exactly one output satisfying the graph.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.realize_totalUnique.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] {n : ℕ} (A : L.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit)) :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.totalUnique A ↔
    ∀ (x : Fin n → M), ∃! y, A.Realize (Sum.elim x fun x => y)
